purpose: Show that people perform an action mutually.
keywords: Let us help one another when things are difficult.
The two of us discussed our travel plans.
The children looked at each other and laughed.
restrictions: Requires an action that can be reciprocal or shared.
mistake: 話し合う means discuss together; it is more than simply speaking simultaneously.
